sources.publisher: Vermont Department of Forests, Parks and Recreation
sources.field_scope: Saved lead, read on this check. Commercial use license or special use permit for organized, publicized, fee-based, or resource-affecting recreation on state land. Guided fishing, hunting, and trapping for groups of less than ten people on ANR lands is stated as exempt. Fees start at $50. Insurance is required. No holder list. An earlier note that the direct read was unavailable is stale.
sources.request_process: The page points to the leases, licenses, and permits page. That application was not opened.

sources.publisher: Vermont Department of Forests, Parks and Recreation
sources.field_scope: Defines commercial use and repeats the under-ten guided fishing, hunting, and trapping exemption on ANR lands. Names a 2008 uses-of-state-lands policy and an online application. The policy PDF and the application were not downloaded. No holder list. Office contacts were not copied.
sources.request_process: Online application linked from the page. The form was not opened. A group-use form is a separate path and was not opened.

sources.field_scope: Portal policies. Footer copyright 2026 State of Vermont. Photo use is limited to personal, non-commercial printing. Commercial use of the photographs is refused. The disclaimer does not grant reuse of a license table. Bulk reuse of a commercial-license file is not addressed.
sources.bulk: Silent on bulk reuse of license files.
sources.attribution: Copyright is asserted. No credit sentence authorizes a third-party directory.
sources.request_process: Copyright notices go to the vendor named on the page. That path was not used as a fishing-roster request.

sources.field_scope: Fish and Wildlife lands rule. Does not apply to fishing access areas. Guiding for fishing, hunting, and trapping by a person is authorized when limited to the stated fish and wildlife activities. Other commercial activity needs a special use permit, lease, or license. A group is defined as ten or more people. Not a roster. The compilation's own effective date for the guiding sentence was not separated from later tree-stand amendments.
sources.attribution: Official compilation, described on the site as an unofficial convenience copy.

sources.field_scope: Fishing access area rule. Commercial activity is prohibited except for persons and entities taking part in the priority angling, motorboat-launch, and hunting or trapping uses. Group use of ten or more people or two or more vehicles needs authorization. The history line cites an effective date of May 18, 2010. Not a guide roster.
sources.attribution: Official compilation, described on the site as an unofficial convenience copy.
sources.request_process: Special permits under section 8.0. No public holder file.

sources.field_scope: Rule defining the Vermont portion of Lake Champlain for reciprocal fishing licenses. Draws the New York border and the eastern line. An angler rule, not a guide roster.
sources.attribution: Official compilation, described on the site as an unofficial convenience copy.

sources.field_scope: Connecticut River and Lake Champlain reciprocity. A New York fishing license may be used in the Vermont portion of Lake Champlain when New York extends the same right. The Vermont portion excludes waters east of named railroad fills. History of the current subsection places the last cited amendment at January 19, 2010. Not a guide roster.
sources.attribution: Official compilation, described on the site as an unofficial convenience copy.

sources.field_scope: Taking fish requires a fishing license, with stated exceptions, including persons under 15. This is an angler credential. No guide registration is in the section. A 2025 amendment is effective July 1, 2025.
sources.attribution: Official compilation, described on the site as an unofficial convenience copy.

sources.field_scope: Commercial angling rule, read as a search extract of the selling and buying sections. A fish-seller endorsement plus a fishing license is required to sell legally harvested fish. A fish-buyer permit runs January 1 through December 31 and requires quarterly reports, including the share from Lake Champlain. This is sale of fish, not a for-hire guide or charter roster. The effective-date line was not captured.
sources.bulk: Rule text. Not a roster. Reports go to the Commissioner. No public file was found.
sources.request_process: Endorsement and permit issued by the Commissioner. No public download was found.
sources.note: Search extract. The section was not downloaded as its own file.

sources.field_scope: Fee-fishing business permit, search extract. The permit covers the holder and clients taking fish from the holder's private pond. Annual fee $50. Not a Lake Champlain charter credential.
Fishing tournament permit. A contest with an entry fee and a prize needs a department permit. Fees as of July 1, 2025 are $10, $30, or $100 by participant count. Not a guide roster.
sources.request_process: Permit from the Department of Fish and Wildlife. The application page was read as a search extract and was not used as a holder file.

sources.field_scope: Department restatement of the lands rule. Guiding for fishing, hunting, and trapping is listed as authorized. Commercial activity on department lands, except access areas, is described as allowed without a permit under ten participants and with a special use permit when the group is larger than ten. Access areas are pointed to a separate rule. No holder list.
sources.request_process: Special use permit, lease, or license from the Commissioner when the page requires one. No public list.

sources.field_scope: License center landing, search extract. Fishing, hunting, and taking wild animals require a license except under stated conditions. Moose and antlerless-deer permits are lotteries. No fishing-guide product and no holder download were on the extract.
sources.request_process: The page points to the license center. The purchase portal was not opened.

sources.field_scope: Access-area FAQ, search extract. States the count of access areas and repeats the priority uses and the commercial-activity limit. An unlisted activity can be requested at least 30 days ahead. Not a guide roster. The more-than-190 and over-200 counts on related pages were not reconciled and were not used as a charter population.
sources.request_process: Special use permit request to the department at least 30 days ahead for an activity the rules do not address.

sources.field_scope: Open-data catalog queries limited to this portal. Guide, outfitter, charter, and commercial use returned zero datasets. Fishing and fish wildlife each returned one 2018 Fish and Wildlife file whose columns are traffic-stop fields. Rows were not downloaded. No commercial-use or guide roster.
sources.bulk: No matching roster file. The portal links to a vendor terms page that was not read as a grant for a license table.
sources.attribution: The fishing hit did not publish a license name in the metadata that was read.
sources.request_process: Catalog search only. No records request was sent.

sources.field_scope: Legislature disclaimer, search extract. The site is a public service. Use is at the user's risk. No warranty is stated in the extract. The extract does not grant reuse of a license table. Statute pages also say the compilation is an unofficial convenience copy.
sources.bulk: Silent on bulk reuse of agency license files.

sources.publisher: Operator pages for Lake Champlain booking candidates
sources.field_scope: First-party pages for five candidates. One Shelburne departure has two large boats and one open boat. A second operator states a cabin-boat length and no landing. A third states no hull length and no Vermont landing. A directory fetch for a Charlotte name did not return a charter page. Identities stay in the private packet. Phones, emails, and personal mailing addresses were not stored.
sources.bulk: No directory grant was found. One site asserts copyright and forbids copying. The others are silent.
sources.attribution: Copyright is asserted where a copyright line was present. Otherwise silent.
sources.request_process: No directory-license contact was published on the pages used for hull evidence.

coverage.population: Commercial use licenses and special use permits for recreation on ANR or state lands
coverage.note: The lead and the leases page describe the authorization and an under-ten guided fishing exemption. No holder file was found.
No fishing-guide registration was found. A fishing license, a fee-fishing pond permit, a tournament permit, and a moose guide permit are different credentials.

coverage.population: Fishing access area commercial-activity authorizations under Appendix section 115
coverage.note: Limited commercial activity is defined. Group use needs authorization. No holder file was found.
Sale of harvested fish, including a Lake Champlain share on buyer reports. Not a charter population. No public file was found.

coverage.population: Examined Lake Champlain booking candidates with a Vermont connection
coverage.note: One large boat is supported on an agreed length and beam at a Shelburne home port. The second large boat is held on conflicting lengths. The open boat is held because its launches are not one landing. A cabin boat is held because no landing is stated. A booking business is held because no hull length and no Vermont landing are stated. Reseller pages were not counted as a second publisher.
